changes.notes: Go-live preparation, nothing turned on. Adds docs/GO-LIVE.md (ordered steps, secret names, the owner's own Rs 1 test, flags that stay OFF, rollback). Forged or unsigned calls are now refused before they can queue on the single writer. Internal-error logs no longer carry e-mails or long secrets. The open health page asks the payment side at most once every 30 seconds. New check for any real payment-side adapter (railContract). New 'npm run guards' proves a test fails when each safety guard is removed. Also includes the console wallet module and the fixed INR pack price (in the repo since 19 Nov, never deployed) and the version files from PR 1.

First live version of the Moneypenny credit ledger on its Cloudflare Worker (code 65b86c8, deployed 19 Nov 2026 IST; time shown is that commit's time because the exact deploy time was not recorded). Built over 17 to 19 Nov 2026 from the Phase 0 build and 19 audit rounds: ledger, spend holds, price list, FX table, AI-ready API, API contract, SQLite Durable Object executor. No payment side or rate source is connected. Changes made after this code (INR fixed pack price and the console wallet module) are in the repo but not deployed; see CHANGELOG.md, Not yet deployed.
